title: Digital Marketing Agency in Billings, MT
metaTitle: Digital Marketing Agency in Billings, MT | TDM
metaDescription: Digital marketing for Billings businesses: SEO, paid ads, social media, websites and video for a city that serves eastern Montana and northern Wyoming.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Billings businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Billings is Montana's largest city and the place a very wide region comes to shop, see a doctor and buy equipment. We help Billings companies stay visible to customers in town and to the ones who drive in from hours away.

sections.heading: A regional hub, not just a city
paragraphs: Billings sits on the Yellowstone River beneath the sandstone cliffs locals call the Rims. It is the commercial centre for eastern Montana, northern Wyoming and the western edge of the Dakotas, a trade area far larger than the city itself. Ranchers, farmers and small-town families come in for hospital appointments, farm machinery, vehicles, furniture and a day of shopping.

That changes who your customer is. A dealer, clinic or retailer in Billings should expect many buyers to come from Miles City, Sheridan, Cody, Red Lodge or Hardin, and should market to them directly. They search before they set out, because nobody wants to drive two hours and find the item is not in stock or the office is closed.
bullets: Stock, hours and services kept accurate online, so out-of-town customers can plan the trip.
Ad targeting widened to the surrounding region for higher-value purchases.
Pages that name the towns you deliver to or travel to.
Click-to-call and directions placed first on mobile pages.
Reviews requested from regional customers as well as locals.

sections.heading: Medicine, energy and agriculture
paragraphs: Healthcare is one of the city's biggest employers. Two major hospital systems anchor a medical corridor near downtown, and patients are referred here from across the region. Around them are specialist practices, dentists, physical therapists and medical suppliers, all of which benefit from clear service pages and accurate listings.

Energy has shaped Billings for generations. Oil refineries operate in the city and in nearby Laurel, and many contractors, fabricators, trucking firms and safety companies serve them and the oil, gas and coal activity further east. Agriculture is just as present: livestock auctions, feed and implement dealers, and lenders and insurers who work with producers. These buyers value straightforward information and a number they can call.

sections.heading: Downtown, the West End and the Heights
paragraphs: Residents divide the city by area. Downtown has offices, the hospitals, restaurants and a walkable run of breweries. The West End is where most new retail, restaurants and housing have gone, along King Avenue and out toward Shiloh Road. The Heights lies north-east beyond the Rims with its own shops and services, and Lockwood and Laurel sit just outside the city.

People use these names in conversation and in searches. A business with one location should say which part of town it is in, and one that serves homes should make clear it covers the Heights, Laurel and Lockwood as well as the West End.

sections.heading: Seasons in Yellowstone County
paragraphs: Winters are cold, and furnace, plumbing and vehicle services are busiest then. The building and roofing season is short, and summer hailstorms can fill a roofer's or body shop's calendar overnight. The fair at MetraPark in August and events through the year bring regional visitors into town for several days at a time.

Summer also brings travellers passing through on the way to Yellowstone by way of Red Lodge and the Beartooth Highway, or to the Little Bighorn battlefield. Hotels, restaurants and outdoor shops can reach them while they plan the route.

presence: TDM works with Billings businesses remotely. We do not have an office or a team member in Billings or elsewhere in Montana. Our team delivers the work online, with scheduled calls and written reports.

faqs.q: Is TDM a local Billings agency?
faqs.a: No. We work with Billings businesses remotely, by video call and shared reporting. We do not have an office in the city.

faqs.q: How far out should a Billings business advertise?
faqs.a: It depends on what you sell. Everyday services should stay close to town. Equipment, vehicles, specialist care and larger purchases can justify reaching into eastern Montana and northern Wyoming, because people already travel to Billings for them.

faqs.q: How do I reach customers in the West End and the Heights?
faqs.a: Mention the areas you serve on your site, keep your business profile's service area accurate and target ads by distance from your location. If you have more than one site, give each its own profile and page.

faqs.q: What does digital marketing cost for a Billings business?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope of work. We quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How long does it take to improve local search rankings?
faqs.a: That depends on your requirements, your starting point and your competitors. We agree the timeline in the plan before work begins.
